name: 万圣节
prompt:
Edit the supplied existing picture locally to add seasonal accessories ONLY. Use the supplied A1-v2 image as the direct and sole reference.
Preserve the original beaver exactly: same head contour, ear positions, tilted viewing angle, eye positions and highlights, nose shape, cream muzzle, gentle smile, short incisors, chestnut/cream colors and soft shading. Preserve its exact scale, position, lower-left emergence, and existing left/bottom cropping. Keep the entire original sage-teal background and its existing tonal appearance unchanged.
Do not reconstruct cropped anatomy, move the face, straighten its angle, center the character, shrink the head, redraw its face, or remove or replace the background. Treat all areas outside the new accessory locations as protected existing artwork.
Fit the accessories into existing upper background space and outer brown perimeter areas. They may cover a small outer edge of the brown head, but must never cover eyes, nose, cream muzzle, smile or teeth. Keep both ears recognizable. Keep all NEW accessories fully inside the original square canvas, with approximately 24 pixels of clearance, without changing the original head crop.
Keep accessory shapes soft, simple, compact and rounded, matching the reference's quiet warmth. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment. Do not add extra scenery, body parts, fur, whiskers, blush, eyebrows, strong shadows, fine ornament, watermarks, frames or a new character.
Deliver one full-resolution square image with the SAME original composition and background.
Accessories to add: Add one small plum-purple witch hat with a blunt rounded tip and gold buckle on the crown between the ears, one compact friendly orange pumpkin lantern on the far lower-right brown outer edge, and a tiny plum bat with blunt rounded wings in the upper-right green space. Nothing scary.
Preserve every original feature and only add these accessories.
editingPolicy: Only accessories added directly to A1-v2; no centered or transparent intermediate.
observation: Original lower-left crop, head scale, tilted face, expression and sage-teal background visibly retained. No automatic retry or postprocessing.
